proposal.reason: Repairs the prior proposal by inlining the built-in comparator behavior instead of invoking an internal helper closure. Within the scoped domain, the export returns a strict memoized callback with per-instance state: it reuses the last successful result only when it has been called before, the current receiver is strictly the same, and either the provided comparator called as a plain strict function with arguments (newArgs, lastArgs) is truthy, or the default comparison holds by equal argument-list length and per-index equality using === except that NaN matches NaN. On cache miss it calls resultFn with the current receiver and full argument list, and only after a successful return updates cached receiver, args, result, and calledOnce; comparator or resultFn throws leave prior cache state unchanged.

proposal.reason: Repair: model export-time defaulting by replacing an omitted/undefined comparator with an internal strict comparator function, then have the returned strict memoized function always invoke its active comparator only after a prior successful call and same receiver. On cache hit it returns the previous result; on miss it calls resultFn with the current receiver and full argument list, and only after a successful return updates cached state. The default comparator matches equal lengths and per-index equality using === with NaN treated as equal to NaN, so signed zeros compare equal.
